result.brief: 提出无编码器VLA框架，用轻量patch卷积将图像与语言在主干中联合演化，并让流匹配动作专家从不同深度的视觉表征取用信息，揭示动作关键信号早于最终视觉表征。
result.reason: Encoder-free VLA where patch-tokenized images evolve jointly with language; layer-wise probing shows action-critical visual signals peak before final representation, a visual representation contribution.
